mechanism: Chlorpromazine increases photosensitivity risk, and tazarotene (a retinoid) also causes photosensitivity and skin irritation, with additive dermatologic adverse effects and potential for severe sun sensitivity.
action: Counsel patient on strict photoprotection (SPF >30 sunscreen, protective clothing, sun avoidance) and monitor for excessive skin irritation, erythema, or phototoxic reactions; consider spacing administration times if possible.
